mocks.title: Agent Ticket Acquisition — headless interface mock
mocks.description: Headless agent acquires primary where we control the sale, secondary sealed bid where we don't — 1 seat vs 4 connected seats, Porto Alegre (route-1 primary) vs Miami (secondary only).
changelog: v1 — 2026-11-18: initial mock, built on the real commerce engine (commerce/engine.mjs); four cases self-asserted.
mocks.objective: Prove the control doctrine in code: primary only where we are seller of record or technology partner; secondary sealed bid everywhere else — at 1-seat and 4-seat scale.
